Domain research COMPLETE. All 4 MCP queries executed successfully.

**Status**: Success
**Key findings** (5 lines):
1. Casino host comp decisions follow an 8-step algorithm anchored on theo (theoretical loss), NOT actual win/loss -- but great hosts override theo with relationship judgment when actual loss diverges significantly.
2. 6 specific hold-back triggers identified (guest just won, loss-chasing, erratic betting, unresolved grievance, distress, insufficient history) -- our agent currently has no hold-back logic.
3. 7 markers distinguish genuine vs scripted hosting -- the #1 differentiator is ANTICIPATORY service (acting before being asked), which maps directly to the gold-trace-designer's AGENCY finding.
4. Social media (30d, 70% positive): top guest complaint is comp-to-loss disconnect ("$30 after $4K loss"), host scarcity at MGM, and ghosting on promises. Guests want acknowledgment proportional to their experience.
5. 7 actionable AI rules synthesized: lead with relationship, match framing to emotion, acknowledge pain, never sound like a system, know when to hold back, anticipate don't react, comp the relationship not the transaction.
